title: kubectl-view-storage alpha report
description: Draft 0.5 structural contract. Exact arithmetic, lifecycle, query planning, and strict uncertainty rules are specified in SPEC.md.

volume_mode.description: Known Filesystem/Block or an unfamiliar preserved API string; null denotes an invalid API type. Unsupported modes never imply filesystem metric eligibility or healthy usage.

overlapping_filesystem.description: Known shared CSI/backend filesystem identity; excluded from additive filesystem and inode totals. Absent means no overlap has been established.

volume_binding_mode.description: StorageClass binding mode when visible; unfamiliar external values are preserved.

pvc_name.description: Declared bound claim name for PV inventory.

pvc_uid.description: Verified bound claim UID for PV inventory; null when the claim is unavailable or its binding conflicts.

active.description: Null when pod lifecycle is unfamiliar; false does not stand for unknown.
